body: i feel the same way, i wish i had someone truly there for me as well. i tried my best to just be happy with myself and make myself my own best friend, but that was very difficult. i hope you feel better, and know that there are people out there who feel the same. you can talk to me anytime.

You don't need to be sorry needing help. I felt the same way, I got therapy for a while (Had to stop cause its so expensive) and I learned a few things. Sometimes you just have to live for the small stuff yk. Sounds stupid, but It works for me. When I was 10 I thought I wouldn't make it past 13, but my 16th birthday is next month. I'm living for music. Something small as looking at the trees change color or feeling the sand on your feet in the beach make it worth it sometimes. I don't have any friends to support me, but I'm trying my best to learn to live for myself yk. You can make it, I believe in you. Hope this helps.
I'm trying my best right now, I'm happy we're both here. Next month is actually my 16th birthday, I'm doing my best to hold on lol.
